source: R2 analysis of mraevq/udhwkz refs + 7 outliers (see research/R2/library.json, transcripts/)

global.caption_unit: one sentence per card, split >12 words; white sans, sentence case, top band above picture
global.voice: single first-person narrator reads narration AND dialogue; radio/phone lines band-passed 300-3000 Hz
global.music: low tension drone; switch to sad piano for false-relief beats; 0.3-0.6 s silence before the reveal
global.frame: 9:16 black canvas, picture panel ~1:1 centred at y 29-71%, captions above, bottom third empty
hook_rules: line 1 <= 12 words, first person past tense, names a concrete place/object
contradiction from a trusted source by second 8-10
cliffhanger_rules: end on a new imperative from the only trustworthy channel OR a reveal that reframes an authority
exactly one open question at the cut
last caption is a full sentence; no jump-scare-only endings
no 'part 2' card needed; caption text may say 'Part 2 is pinned' / put part 1 on top of profile by posting part 2 first

beats.line_pattern: A [threat] got into my [building].

beats.shot: warning channel appears (note / unknown text / overlay)
beats.line_pattern: Then [warning channel] said: [the authority is the threat].

beats.shot: peephole fisheye on authority; push-in on wrong detail
beats.line_pattern: Shouldn't [authority] always [norm]? And why [wrong detail]?

beats.shot: phone: burst of 3 agreeing neighbours, then 2 doubters ignored
beats.clue: count of agreeing accounts == count tied to the wrong detail

beats.line_pattern: [Unit] is uncooperative. Requesting backup.

beats.shot: status bar 'No Service', failed red (!) message; but group chat still works
beats.line_pattern: Only the group chat still worked. Why?

beats.shot: phone: brave neighbour warning -> 'message recalled by admin' -> 'admin muted all'

beats.line_pattern: Everything was a setup. [backstory clue].

beats.shot: hidden old device; countdown battery; degraded call
beats.line_pattern: [Device] had [N] seconds left. I called [real authority].
It's not one [threat]. It's [bigger]. And your [authority] isn't [name].
Before it died, one message came in: [imperative].
Every [profession/resident] knows you never [rule].
People say it's [polite reason]. Honestly, everyone's just scared of [real reason].
Tonight, [situation that tempts breaking it].
[Companion]: Why are we [obeying]? Just [break it].
My mentor drilled one thing into me: [rule detail].
But [companion/hero] [broke it].

beats.shot: subtle wrongness in companion (seatbelt slipped, face turned away)

beats.line_pattern: I only realised when I saw [detail tying companion to the dead].
[Companion] said: [line that proves they are not themselves].

templates.name: 2 A.M. Sound + Online Stranger Who Knows

beats.line_pattern: At [time], I was woken by [specific sound] [location].
Every time I checked, it stopped. It had been [N] nights.

beats.shot: phone: DM from user with odd handle
beats.line_pattern: A user named [handle] messaged me: That's [named entity]. [rule to survive].
Quit making stuff up. / I'm telling you the truth. Check [evidence].

beats.note: follow the stranger's rule; it half-works
the stranger knows too much / is the entity / is from the future

templates.name: Watched: Floating Comments / Overlay Layer
templates.derived_from: mraevq danmaku layer (mechanic only; design our own overlay)
rules: overlay appears at the first decision point and at every subsequent one
overlay voices: 1 helpful, 1 cynical, 1 comic bettor (sets up a callback payoff)
mid-story reveal: the overlay is an audience watching the hero as entertainment
payoff: hero outsmarts both the threat and the cynical overlay voice; callback line lands
overlay is never fully reliable: one helpful comment is planted by the villains
